profile.headline: Interactive Software Developer
profile.summary:
Interactive Media and Computer Graphics Software Developer with experience building software for museum exhibition, feature animation, and motion capture.

Previous work has included interactive media, artist and pipeline tools, motion capture, multimedia production, and technical support.

Recent experience with: C#, Unity 3D, Adobe Creative Suite, MATLAB, Arduino, Windows

Past experience with: C++98, Python, JavaScript, HTML, MEL, GLSL, Cg, Maya API, MotionBuilder OpenReality SDK, Direct3D, OpenGL, WebGL, Autodesk Maya, MotionBuilder, 3D Studio Max, Mac / Linux OS

positions.title: Interactive Software Developer
positions.description: Lead developer for the Science Behind Pixar exhibition, on tour in the United States, Canada, Hong Kong, and Japan.

positions.title: Animation Technology R&D Intern
positions.description: Worked with Front-End Tools R&D team to develop Autodesk Maya plugins and tools for production artists. Projects focused on custom manipulators, camera culling, and removal of overlapping geometry.

positions.title: Multimedia & Technical Artist
positions.description: Responsible for multimedia production, software development, and technical support. Work included graphic design, web development, videography, photography, post production, motion capture, computer graphics, application plugins, pipeline tools, 3D visualization, gaming, and human-computer interaction
